title: Ravex core
description: RavexCore is a powerful, all-in-one commands plugin designed for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Paper/Spigot servers). It provides a comprehensive set of admin and player commands to enhance your server experience.
body:

- Ravex core Plugin

RavexCore Plugin Commands
RavexCore is a comprehensive Minecraft plugin for version 1.21.11 that adds essential commands for both administrators and players.

👑 Admin Commands
/fly - Toggle flight mode for yourself
/vanish - Become invisible to all other players
/namehide - Hide your nametag from everyone
/invsee <player> - View and manage another player's inventory
/hlsee <player> - Check a player's health and food levels
/food @a - Restore food to maximum for all online players
/ie <enchant> <level> - Enchant the item you're holding with any level
/lang <ar|en> - Switch between Arabic and English language
/setwarp <name> - Create a new warp point at your location
/setspawn - Set the server's main spawn location
/delwarp <name> - Delete an existing warp point

🎮 Player Commands
/tpa <player> - Send a teleport request to another player
/sethome - Set your personal home location
/home - Teleport to your home location
/spawn - Teleport to the server spawn point
/warp <name> - Teleport to a specific warp location
/claim - Claim the current chunk as your territory
/unclaim - Remove your claim from the current chunk
/death - Teleport to your last death location
/kill - Kill yourself instantly
/delhome - Delete your home location
/tpaccept - Accept a pending teleport request
/tpdeny - Deny a pending teleport request
